paragraphs: Tavi, or Tabi: “R. Yochanan said.” In R. Hamnuna's name: Jerusalem Talmud, beginning of Lulav HaGazul. In R. Chisda's name: Jerusalem Talmud, Kirah, halakhah 7. “R. Yoshiyah said”—Berakhot 15b, two statements; HaRoeh, 63a; Yoma 65b; Hayah Kore, Berakhot 16b; Chelek, Sanhedrin 92a in the checked edition; Jerusalem Talmud, Metziat HaIshah, halakhah 6; introduction to Eikhah. R. Yoshiyah son of R. Yannai: Terumot, chapter 2, end of halakhah 1. In Kahana's name: beginning of Shekalim. He raised a contradiction for Rav Nachman: Temurah 34a. In Shmuel's name: Jerusalem Talmud, HaArel, and end of R. Eliezer DeMilah.
